title: Cornell’s Chi Phi Chapter Faces Scrutiny Over Assault Accusations
summary: Chi Phi’s Cornell chapter was shuttered after a woman said its members sexually assaulted her. It was one of the oldest fraternities at the school, where Greek life has thrived.
